content.user_title: Optimize SQL With Expert Database Guidance
content.value_statement: Complex SQL work can slow teams when schemas, indexes, and workloads are unclear. This skill guides query tuning, schema design, and cloud database decisions.
actual_capabilities: Designs SQL queries for analytics, reporting, and operational workloads across relational and cloud database platforms.
Reviews query plans and suggests indexes, partitions, and access path changes.
Guides schema design for OLTP, OLAP, HTAP, time-series, and warehouse use cases.
Explains database security patterns such as row-level security, masking, encryption, and role-based access control.
Plans database migrations, replication, backups, monitoring, and performance benchmarking.
limitations: Requires schema details, workload context, and query plans for precise tuning recommendations.
Does not connect to databases or execute queries by itself.
Cannot verify production performance without measured data and representative test workloads.
Recommendations must be reviewed for each database engine and version.

use_cases.title: Tune Slow Reporting Queries
use_cases.description: Analyze execution plans, table sizes, and indexes to reduce latency in dashboards and reports.

use_cases.title: Design Application Schemas
use_cases.description: Create practical table models, constraints, indexes, and tenant patterns for transactional applications.

use_cases.title: Plan Cloud Database Changes
use_cases.description: Compare database platforms, migration options, replication patterns, and cost controls for growing systems.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Slow Query
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this slow SQL query and explain likely bottlenecks. Ask for missing schema or plan details before recommending changes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reporting Schema
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reporting schema for these business metrics, source tables, freshness needs, and expected query patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Tune an Analytical Workload
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this analytical workload across table sizes, partitions, indexes, and execution plans. Recommend safe tuning steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Cloud Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a migration plan from this current database to a cloud-native SQL platform. Include risks, validation, rollback, and performance checks.

output_examples.input: A dashboard query scans a large orders table and times out during business hours.
output: Identifies full-table scans, missing selective indexes, and aggregation pressure as likely causes.
Recommends reviewing execution plans, adding a targeted composite index, and testing on a read replica.

output_examples.input: A SaaS team needs a multi-tenant database model with compliance controls.
output: Compares shared-table, schema-per-tenant, and database-per-tenant designs.
Highlights tenant isolation, backup scope, row-level security, and operational cost tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: A team plans to move analytics from a legacy warehouse to a cloud platform.
output: Outlines migration phases for discovery, data validation, workload testing, and cutover.
Calls out cost controls, partition strategy, access controls, and rollback planning.

best_practices: Provide table sizes, indexes, query plans, and database engine versions with each request.
Test tuning recommendations in staging before applying them to production.
Include workload goals, latency targets, and data growth assumptions.
anti_patterns: Asking for optimization without schema, indexes, or execution plans.
Running exploratory analysis directly on production without limits or read replicas.
Copying database-specific advice across engines without compatibility checks.

faq.question: Can this skill write SQL queries?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft queries when you provide goals, schema details, and database engine information.

faq.question: Can it optimize existing queries?
faq.answer: Yes. It works best when you include the query, execution plan, indexes, and table sizes.

faq.question: Does it connect to my database?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance from the information you share and does not execute database commands.

faq.question: Which databases does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers relational, cloud-native, warehouse, HTAP, time-series, and SQL-compatible database platforms.

faq.question: Can it help with database security?
faq.answer: Yes. It can explain access control, masking, encryption, audit trails, and SQL injection prevention.

faq.question: Is it safe for production work?
faq.answer: Use it for planning and review. Validate every change in staging before production deployment.
